criterion: A journal directory that cannot be listed is reported by doctor rather than reducing the whole history to silence
summary: Reproduced before it was fixed: with the journal directory at chmod 000, journal_months was empty, journal_bytes was zero and warnings was empty - the history did not look short, it looked absent. The cause is that Path.glob swallows the PermissionError from an unreadable directory and yields nothing, which makes a journal nobody can list identical to one nobody has written; that is why the first attempt at this fix, which wrapped the glob in a try, changed nothing. os.scandir is asked instead and the two answers are now distinct: FileNotFoundError is a first run and returns nothing, and any other OSError reports the directory. Verified across four states - unlistable, listable with unstattable children, healthy, and never written - each giving its own answer. Pinned by test_a_journal_directory_that_cannot_be_listed_is_reported, which asserts both that the months list is empty and that the warning says 'empty rather than short', because the distinction between losing one month and losing all of them is the point.
